crossRefs.note: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,
You shall not remove your neighbor’s landmark, which they of old time have set, in your inheritance which you shall…
‘Cursed is he who removes his neighbor’s landmark.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.

translations.web: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up.
translations.bsb: Do not move an ancient boundary stone which your fathers have placed.
translations.kjv: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.
translations.asv: Remove not the ancient landmark, Which thy fathers have set.
